name: Tinker's Gloves

effects.name: Dexterity
effects.tooltip: Dexterity +6 : This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

effects.name: Insightful Seeker
effects.tooltip: Insightful Seeker +2 : Provides a +2 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +2 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

effects.name: Open Lock
effects.tooltip: Open Lock +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Open Lock skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Open Lock
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Open Lock +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Open Lock skill.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Tinker's Finesse
effects.tooltip: Tinker's Finesse : True Seeing , and equivalent to Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 to attack rolls and +8 damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

flavor_text: Gloves worn by House Cannith tinkers to grant them greater dexterity and aid them in working with complex devices.

source.detail: Whitefang 's chest some End chests ; House Cannith Manufactury Stellite 's chest (Rare Encounter).
source.raw: Schemes of the Enemy , Whitefang 's chest, some End chests ; House Cannith Manufactury , Stellite 's chest (Rare Encounter).
